title: Define Facility Registry entity types and the MFL relationship
requirements:
- Add an entity model distinguishing organisations, facilities, locations, service sites, mobile and temporary services, mapped to mCSD/FHIR
- Describe the registry as a governed capability (people, process, data, technology), not only 'the technology'
- Replace 'within the Ministry's mandate' with nationally defined health-sector oversight scope
- Allow countries to start from a governed MFL and progress
- Publish configurable inclusion rules with in- and out-of-scope examples
- Require one authoritative arrangement; any separate MFL is derived or formally synchronised
- Give classification rules for when a temporary service is a facility, location or event
